instruction: Masarata na da layuka masu tsagewa masu launin rawaya suna gudu tare da ganye kuma shuke-shuke sun taƙaita. Wannan cutar mosaic ta rogo ce?
response:
A'a — wannan Cutar Streak ta Masara ce (Maize Streak Virus), ba cutar mosaic ta rogo ba. Cutar mosaic ta rogo tana shafar rogo kaɗai; a kan masara, layukan da suka tsage masu launin rawaya da ke gudu tare da jijiyoyi tare da taƙaitawa su ne streak na masara, wanda leafhopper ke yaɗawa (ba ƙudan zuma fari ba). Magancewa:
1. Ciro ka lalata shuke-shuke da suka fi taƙaita.
2. Magance ciyawa da leafhopper a kewayen gona.
3. Kaka mai zuwa shuka irin masara mai jurewa streak kamar irin SAMMAZ, shuka da wuri kuma a bulo ɗaya.
Babu maganin shuka da ya kamu, don haka iri masu jurewa da shuka da wuri su ne kariyarka.

instruction: Ganyen rogona na da tabo masu kusurwa masu launin ruwan kasa da danko na fitowa daga ƙwaya, tare da bushewar kan tsire-tsire. Wace cuta ce wannan?
response:
Wannan Cutar Bacterial Blight ta Rogo ce, ba cutar mosaic ta rogo ba. Alamun sune tabo masu kusurwa masu ruwa masu launin ruwan kasa, bushewar kan tsire-tsire, kuma musamman danko na fitowa daga ƙwaya — mosaic kuwa tana nuna tsari na rawaya-da-kore gauraye da ganye lankwashe ba tare da danko ba. Yana yaɗuwa ta ƙwayoyin da suka kamu da ruwan sama mai fesawa. Magancewa:
1. Yi amfani da ƙwayoyi masu tsafta daga shuke-shuke masu lafiya da irin mai jurewa kamar TMS 30572.
2. Cire ka ƙone shuke-shuke da suka yi tsanani.
3. Juya rogo da masara ko legume kuma ka guji taɓa amfanin lokacin da ganye ke jiƙe.

instruction: Ganyen rogona na da tsari na rawaya da kore gauraye kuma sun lankwashe suna ƙanana. Wannan bacterial blight ce?
response:
A'a — wannan Cutar Mosaic ta Rogo ce, ba bacterial blight ba. Mosaic tana nuna tsari na rawaya-da-kore gauraye da ganye lankwashe ƙanana ba tare da danko a ƙwaya ba; bacterial blight kuwa tana da tabo masu kusurwa masu launin ruwan kasa da danko na fitowa daga ƙwaya. Mosaic ƙwayar cuta ce da ƙudan zuma fari da ƙwayoyin da suka kamu ke yaɗawa. Magancewa:
1. Ciro ka ƙone shuke-shuke da suka yi tsanani.
2. Shuka ƙwayoyi masu tsafta kawai daga gonaki masu lafiya kuma yi amfani da irin mai jurewa kamar TME 419.
3. Magance ƙudan zuma fari.
Babu maganin da ya kamu, don haka ƙwayoyi masu tsafta su ne mabuɗi.

instruction: Shuke-shuken tumatirata suna bushewa suna mutuwa ba zato amma ganye na zama kore ba tare da tabo ba. Wannan late blight ce?
response:
A'a — wannan bacterial wilt ce, ba late blight ba. Late blight tana nuna tabo masu ruwa duhu da farin fumfuna a ganye; bacterial wilt ba ta da wannan — shuka kawai tana bushewa tana mutuwa yayin da ganye ke ci gaba da zama kore. Tabbatar da shi ta yanke ƙwaya mai bushewa ka tsaida shi cikin ruwa mai tsafta: danko kamar madara na fitowa yana nufin bacterial wilt. Babu magani, don haka:
1. Ciro shuke-shuke da suka kamu nan da nan.
2. Juya daga tumatir, tattasai, yalo da dankali na shekaru biyu zuwa uku.
3. Shuka a kan kunya mai magudanar ruwa mai kyau ka yi amfani da dashe masu jurewa ko waɗanda aka haɗa (grafted).

instruction: Ganyen tumatirata na da tabo masu ruwa duhu da farin fumfuna a ƙasa, suna yaɗuwa da sauri a yanayi mai sanyi da ruwa. Wannan early blight ce?
response:
A'a — wannan late blight ce, ba early blight ba. Early blight tana nuna tabo duhu masu zobe kamar hari, galibi a tsofaffin ganye; late blight kuwa ita ce tabo masu ruwa masu saurin yaɗuwa da farin fumfuna a ƙarƙashin ganye da ke rushe shuka cikin 'yan kwanaki a yanayi mai sanyi da danshi. Yi mataki da sauri:
1. Cire ka binne ko ƙone ganye da shuke-shuke da suka kamu.
2. Feshe mancozeb (kimanin gram 50 a knapsack na lita 15-16) kowane kwana 7 a yanayi mai ruwa; ga harin da ke gudana yi amfani da maganin metalaxyl da mancozeb.
3. Sa sanduna, faɗaɗa nisa, ka ba da ruwa a tushe ba a sama ba.

instruction: Ganyen shinkafata na da tabo masu siffar lu'ulu'u da tsakiya masu launin toka. Wannan brown spot ce?
response:
A'a — tabo masu siffar lu'ulu'u da tsakiya masu launin toka da gefe launin ruwan kasa su ne rice blast, ba brown spot ba. Brown spot kuwa tana yin ƙananan tabo masu zagaye masu launin ruwan kasa kuma galibi tana nuni ga talaucin ƙasa. Magance blast:
1. Shuka irin mai jurewa blast da ya dace da yankinka.
2. Kada ka yi wuce gona da iri na nitrogen — raba urea zuwa ma'auni matsakaici.
3. Inganta magudanar ruwa ka guji cunkoso; a harin mai tsanani yi amfani da maganin fungus kamar tricyclazole a ma'aunin lakabin kusa da fitowar kai don hana blast na wuya.

instruction: Masarata da aka ajiye tana da ƙananan ramuka masu zagaye, foda kamar gari, da ƙananan ƙwaro. Waɗannan stem borer ne ko diamondback moth?
response:
Babu ɗayansu — wannan weevil na masara ne, kwaron ma'aji. Stem borer yana huda cikin ƙwayoyin masara masu tsayawa a gona, diamondback moth kuwa tsutsa ce ta ganyen kabeji; babu ɗayansu da ke kai wa hatsin da aka ajiye hari. Ƙananan ramuka masu zagaye, ƙura kamar gari da ƙananan ƙwaro a ma'ajinka su ne weevil. Kare hatsi:
1. Bushe shi har sai ya fashe maimakon ya lanƙwasa (kimanin kashi 13 na danshi).
2. Ajiye a buhunan da ba sa shigar iska (hermetic) kamar buhun PICS uku-uku, ko ganguna masu tsafta rufaffe.
3. Idan kana amfani da buhu na yau da kullum, gauraya ingantaccen maganin kariya kamar foda na pirimiphos-methyl (Actellic) a ma'aunin lakabin, ka bi lokacin jira kafin cin hatsin.

instruction: Kan rogona na cike da farin kwari kamar auduga kuma ganye sun taru sun taƙaita. Waɗannan aphids ne, kuma zan iya feshe ivermectin?
response:
Waɗannan mealybug na rogo ne, ba aphids ba — kuma kada ka yi amfani da ivermectin, wanda maganin tsutsotsi ne na dabbobi kuma ba shi da wuri a kan amfani. Mealybug na yin farin murfi kamar auduga a kan kan tsire-tsire tare da ganye taru, taƙaita; aphids kuwa ƙananan kwari ne masu laushi da ke taruwa a kan tsire-tsire ba tare da murfin auduga ba. Magance mealybug:
1. Fara da ƙwayoyi masu tsafta daga shuke-shuke marasa kwari.
2. Kare abokin gaba na halitta, ƙaramin ƙwaron parasitic, ta hanyar guje wa feshin sinadarai mara zaɓe.
3. Ga wuraren da suka yi tsanani, yanke ka ƙone kawunan da suka kamu ko ka feshe man neem (kimanin cokali 3 da ɗan sabulu a lita 1 na ruwa) a kan kan tsire-tsire, ka maimaita bayan mako.

instruction: Akwai ramuka da bayan gari kamar ƙurar itace a cikin ramin masarata. Wannan stem borer ne?
response:
A'a — barnar da ke cikin ramin (whorl) tare da ramuka da bayan gari mai laima ita ce kwaron soja (fall armyworm), ba stem borer ba. Stem borer kuwa yana huda cikin ƙwayar, yana barin ƙura busasshe a ramukan da ke kan ƙwayar kuma wani lokaci yana kashe wurin girma. Ga kwaron soja:
1. Duba sau biyu a mako ka yi magani idan kimanin shuka 1 cikin 5 sun nuna sabuwar barna a ramin.
2. Sa neem cikin ramin, ko ingantaccen magani kamar emamectin benzoate (kimanin gram 10 a knapsack na lita 15-20) a feshe cikin ramin da safe ko yamma, ka canza rukunin magani don guje wa juriya.

instruction: Taron fara na cinye dukan amfanina. Yaya zan sarrafa su?
response:
Fara kwari ne na amfanin gona da za a sarrafa, ba dabbobin kiwo ba — wannan matsalar sarrafa kwari ce, ba ta shinge ba. Yi mataki da sauri, kuma inda zai yiwu tare da maƙwabtanka:
1. Sanar da ofishin noma na jiharka nan da nan idan taro ne na gaskiya, domin ana tsara babban maganin a can.
2. Kai hari ga ƙananan ɗango da wuri, kafin su iya tashi, yayin da suke a taru a ƙasa.
3. Feshe wuraren da suka kamu da gefen gona da ingantaccen magani kamar lambda-cyhalothrin a ma'aunin lakabin, ka niyya inda suke huta da safe.
Share tsayin ciyawa inda suke ɓoye, kuma ka nome bayan hari don fallasa ƙwan da aka binne.

instruction: Awakina suna da zazzaɓi, ruwa daga idanu da hanci, gyambon baki, da gudawa, kuma wasu suna mutuwa. Wannan Fowl Pox ce?
response:
A'a — Fowl Pox cutar tsuntsaye ce, ba ta awaki ba. A cikin awaki da tumaki, zazzaɓi tare da ruwa daga idanu da hanci, gyambon baki da gudawa mai wari da ke kashe dabbobi da yawa shi ne PPR (peste des petits ruminants), cuta mai saurin yaɗuwa. Babu magani idan sun kamu, don haka:
1. Raba dabbobi marasa lafiya da garke mai lafiya nan da nan kuma kada ka motsa ko ka sayar da dabbobi daga garken.
2. Yi wa dabbobi masu lafiya allurar rigakafin PPR, wanda ke kariya na kimanin shekara, ka yi kowace shekara.
3. Tsabtace garuka ka zubar da gawawwaki lafiya.
Allurar rigakafin PPR ta kowace shekara ita ce ke hana ta da gaske.

instruction: Kajina na mutuwa ba zato da kashi mai kore da wuyoyi masu murɗewa. Menene shi kuma me zan yi?
response:
Wannan Cutar Newcastle ce, cuta mai saurin yaɗuwa ta kaji — mutuwa ba zato, kashi mai ruwa mai kore da wuyoyi masu murɗewa ko shanyewa su ne alamun. Ba matsalar abinci, ruwa ko calcium ba ce. Babu magani da ke warkar da kajin da suka kamu, don haka:
1. Raba kaji marasa lafiya nan da nan kuma kada ka kai kaji zuwa wasu gonaki ko kasuwa.
2. Cire ka binne ko ƙone matattun kaji ka wanke keji, wuraren ciyarwa da masha.
3. Yi wa kaji masu lafiya da masu zuwa allurar rigakafin Newcastle (kamar irin Lasota) a lokaci — wannan ita ce kariya ta gaskiya.
Ba da ruwa mai tsabta da bitamin don tallafa wa masu rai.

instruction: 'Yan kajina suna da rauni, suna taruwa, kuma suna yin kashi mai jini. Wannan Cutar Newcastle ce?
response:
A'a — kashi mai jini a 'yan kaji masu taruwa yana nuni ga coccidiosis, ba Newcastle ba. Newcastle tana haddasa mutuwa ba zato da kashi mai kore da wuyoyi masu murɗewa; coccidiosis kuwa kwaron ciki ne da ke haddasa kashi mai jini ko launin ruwan kasa kuma yana yaɗuwa a shimfiɗa jiƙe. Magancewa:
1. Yi wa garken magani da sauri da amprolium a cikin ruwan sha a ma'aunin da adadin kwanaki da aka lakaba.
2. Riƙe shimfiɗa da bushewa ka canza wuraren jiƙe.
3. Kada ka cika su, ka tsabtace masha da wuraren ciyarwa akai-akai.
Shimfiɗa bushe da magani da sauri suna ceton 'yan kaji da yawa.

instruction: Zan iya feshe ivermectin a kan kayan lambuna don kashe kwari?
response: A'a — ivermectin maganin tsutsotsi ne da maganin ƙwari na dabbobi (ana bayarwa ta allura ko zuba a jiki don tsutsotsi, ƙazamta da ƙwarƙwata); ba maganin kashe kwari na amfanin gona ba ne kuma bai kamata a taɓa feshe shi a kan tsire-tsire ko amfanin abinci ba. Ga kwari a kan kayan lambu, yi amfani da magani da aka amince da shi don wannan amfanin da kwaron — misali man neem ga ƙaramin hari, ko ingantaccen magani kamar lambda-cyhalothrin a ma'aunin lakabin ga hari mai tsanani, a feshe da safe ko yamma. Ka gaya mini amfanin da kwaron zan iya ba da cikakken bayani.

instruction: Gefen tsofaffin ganyen masarata suna zama launin ruwan kasa suna ƙonewa, kuma ƙwayoyin sun raunana. Wannan rashin nitrogen ne?
response:
A'a — zama launin ruwan kasa da ƙonewa a gefen tsofaffin ganye tare da ƙwayoyi masu rauni shi ne rashin potassium, ba nitrogen ba. Rashin nitrogen kuwa yana nuna rawaya gaba ɗaya na tsofaffin ganye na ƙasa, galibi kamar V daga bakin ganye, ba tare da ƙonewar gefe ba. Don gyara potassium:
1. Sa muriate of potash, ko taki mai potassium mai yawa kamar NPK 12-12-17, a gefe kusa da shuke-shuke a ba da ruwa.
2. Mayar da ragowar amfani da toka ga ƙasa.
3. A ƙasa mai yashi, raba shi zuwa ma'auni biyu.
Potassium yana da muhimmanci ga cika hatsi da ƙwayoyi masu ƙarfi.

instruction: Tsofaffin ganyen masarata na ƙasa suna zama rawaya, suna farawa daga bakin ganye kamar V. Wannan rashin potassium ne?
response: A'a — rawaya na tsofaffin ganye na ƙasa kamar V daga bakin ganye shi ne rashin nitrogen, ba potassium ba. Rashin potassium kuwa yana ƙone gefen ganye ya raunana ƙwayoyi. Don gyara nitrogen: yi ƙarin urea (46-0-0), kimanin buhu 2.5 (kilo 125) a kowace hekta, a sanya santimita 10 daga shuke-shuke a kan ƙasa mai laima. Za ka ga sabbin ganye suna komawa kore cikin kwana 7 zuwa 10.

instruction: Ƙananan masarata na da ganye da ƙwayoyi masu launin shunayya. Cuta ce?
response:
A'a — launin shunayya ko ja a kan ƙananan ganye da ƙwayoyin masara, tare da girma a hankali da taƙaita, shi ne rashin phosphorus, ba cuta ba, musamman a ƙasa mai sanyi ko acid. Ba ƙwayar cuta ko fungus ba ne, don haka kada ka feshe komai. Maimakon haka:
1. Sa tushen phosphorus kamar single super phosphate, ko NPK 15-15-15, kusa da saiwoyi tun da phosphorus ba ya motsawa nesa a ƙasa.
2. Idan ƙasar na da acid, sa lemun noma, wanda ke buɗe phosphorus.
3. Ƙara takin dabbobi.
Gyara shi da wuri, domin phosphorus yana tura girmar saiwa da wuri.

instruction: A wanne nisa da zurfi zan shuka masara?
response: Shuka masara a layuka masu nisan santimita 75, da shuke-shuke santimita 25 a cikin layin, iri ɗaya zuwa biyu a kowane rami, kimanin santimita 3 zuwa 5 zurfi. Wannan yana ba da kimanin shuke-shuke 53,000 a kowace hekta. Kada ka shuka shi da zurfi kamar doya, kuma kada ka bar nisa mita ɗaya — cunkoso ko faɗaɗawa da yawa duka suna rage amfaninka. Shuka da zuwan ruwan sama mai dogaro ka cire ciyawa a makonni shida na farko.

instruction: A wanne nisa zan shuka wake?
response: Sa layukan wake kimanin santimita 60 nesa da juna da shuke-shuke santimita 20 a cikin layin, iri biyu a kowane rami — ba nisan mita ɗaya ba, wanda ya yi faɗi sosai kuma yana ɓata ƙasa. Shuka a ƙasa mai magudanar ruwa mai kyau da zuwan ruwan sama, ko a Agusta don amfanin ƙwaya da ke nunawa a lokacin bushe. Wake yana samar da nasa nitrogen, don haka yana buƙatar ɗan taki kaɗan.

instruction: Wadanne ingantattun iri zan shuka don masara, rogo, wake, da tumatir?
response:
Yi amfani da irin da aka noma don kowane amfani — ba za a iya musanya su ba:
- Masara: irin masu jurewa streak kamar irin SAMMAZ ko Oba Super.
- Rogo: ingantattun iri kamar TME 419 ko TMS 30572.
- Wake: irin SAMPEA, misali SAMPEA 14.
- Tumatir: irin kamar Roma VF, UC 82, ko ingantaccen iri na gida ko hybrid.
Kada ka taɓa shuka irin rogo kamar TME 419 ko irin wake kamar SAMPEA don tumatir — koyaushe daidaita irin da amfanin, ka sami ingantaccen iri na yankinka daga wanda ake dogara.
